name: Warsong Saw Blades
summary: At Splintertree Post, the Warsong loggers wait on blades from Ratchet. Pixel, their courier, will trade the shipment for a weapon to protect herself on Ashenvale's dangerous roads. The blades are needed to keep the Horde's lumber camps working.

sections.title: A Courier's Shrewd Barter
sections.body: Pixel has brought heavy saw blades from Ratchet to Splintertree Post, but she will not hand them over for free. In Ashenvale's wilds, she values safety more than coin. She asks for a Deadly Blunderbuss in trade, so she can protect herself on her dangerous travels through hostile territory.

sections.title: Supplying the War Effort
sections.body: The Horde needs timber from Ashenvale to ease shortages across Durotar and the Barrens. Axes dull quickly against the ancient groves, so the Warsong loggers need goblin-forged blades. Pixel's shipment supplies the lumber camps, where the Horde cuts timber for outposts and war machines despite fierce resistance from the night elves.

faq.q: Who is Pixel and why does she have the saw blades?
faq.answer: Pixel is a courier at Splintertree Post who brought saw blades from Ratchet. She keeps the shipment until she can secure a weapon for her protection.

faq.q: Why does Pixel want a Deadly Blunderbuss instead of gold?
faq.answer: Pixel considers personal safety more valuable than coin on the dangerous road from the Barrens into Ashenvale. She asks for a Deadly Blunderbuss to defend herself on her travels.

faq.q: Why are these saw blades so important to the Horde?
faq.answer: The Warsong Clan needs timber for the Horde's outposts and war machines. Axes wear down against Ashenvale's ancient trees, so the lumber camps rely on imported mechanical blades.

faq.q: Where did the saw blades originally come from?
aliases: where did saw blades come from
faq.answer: The saw blades came from Ratchet and were hauled overland to Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Where does this quest fit into the Warsong logging effort?
faq.answer: The saw blades are one of the supplies needed to keep the Warsong lumber camps working in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Can anyone make the weapon Pixel wants?
faq.answer: Skilled Engineers can craft a Deadly Blunderbuss from copper tubes, copper bolts, a wooden stock, and leather. Couriers and warriors can also trade for one through local markets or fellow adventurers.

angles.text: As an Engineer, you can craft the Deadly Blunderbuss Pixel wants. Engineering supplies weapons and machinery for the Horde's war effort.
As a member of the Horde, you depend on Ashenvale's lumber camps for timber to build in Orgrimmar. Each machinery delivery helps keep the camps working.
As an orc, you know the Warsong Clan stakes its pride on logging Ashenvale under Grommash Hellscream. Keeping the blades turning supports the clan's foothold in the forest.
